methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected for each vendor on the accessed date. Where official vendor plan pages returned HTTP 406/503/timeout/CAPTCHA or rendered JS-only, pricing was independently re-verified on 2026-06-14 against official vendor help/support pages (instacart.com/instacart-plus, help.shipt.com pricing pages, kroger.com/pr/boost/faq, help.doordash.com) and reputable price-tracking comparison sources (dealnews.com). VERIFIER CORRECTIONS (2026-06-14): (1) Amazon Prime monthly corrected from a stale $12.99 (the 2018 rate) to the current $14.99/month confirmed by dealnews.com and multiple 2026 sources; annual $139/year unchanged. (2) Shipt monthly plan ($10.99/month) added — it is published self-serve on help.shipt.com and was previously omitted. (3) Target Circle 360 monthly plan ($10.99/month) added — published self-serve on help.shipt.com (Shipt powers Target Circle 360). (4) Kroger Boost corrected to its actual two-tier structure with monthly options: Boost Essential ($69/year or $8.99/month) and Boost ($99/year or $12.99/month), confirmed via thekrazycouponlady.com and grocerydive.com following the April 10 2025 price change. For all plans: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null (non-telephony vertical). hipaa/baa are null (consumer grocery delivery, no PHI). For plans billed annually, monthlyUsd is the annualized monthly equivalent (annual total divided by 12); the month-to-month rate and annual total are noted. annualDiscountPct is calculated where both monthly and annual rates are published.

vendors.name: Instacart+
vendors.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-14 directly from instacart.com/instacart-plus, which renders the FAQ text 'For a flat standard fee of $99/year or $9.99/month, members enjoy exclusive benefits.' Corroborated by multiple 2026 comparison sources confirming $9.99/month and $99/year unchanged.

plans.name: Instacart+ Monthly
plans.notes: $9.99 billed each month. Free delivery on eligible orders over $10; reduced service fees; 5% credit back on eligible pickup orders. Family account sharing included. 14-day free trial for new members.

plans.name: Instacart+ Annual
plans.notes: $99/year billed upfront (~$8.25/month). Same benefits as monthly plan plus Peacock and NYT Cooking. Saves ~$20.88 vs 12 months at $9.99. annualDiscountPct = (9.99-8.25)/9.99 rounded to nearest integer.

vendors.name: Walmart+
vendors.provenance: Official walmart.com/plus returned a CAPTCHA screen. Pricing re-verified 2026-06-14 against reputable 2026 comparison coverage (dealnews.com, cnbc.com/select, clark.com), all confirming $12.95/month or $98/year standard, $6.47/month or $49/year for Walmart+ Assist (income-qualified), and the $19.95/month InHome tier.

plans.name: Walmart+ Monthly
plans.notes: $12.95/month billed monthly. Includes free same-day delivery, Paramount+ Essential streaming, fuel discounts, Scan & Go, free shipping on Walmart.com. 30-day free trial available.

plans.name: Walmart+ Annual
plans.notes: $98/year billed upfront (~$8.17/month). Same benefits as monthly. annualDiscountPct = (12.95-8.17)/12.95 rounded to nearest integer.

plans.name: Walmart+ Assist Monthly
plans.notes: $6.47/month. Discounted tier for eligible college students and government-assistance recipients (SNAP, WIC, Medicaid) — approximately 50% off standard pricing. Same benefits as standard Walmart+.

plans.name: Walmart+ Assist Annual
plans.notes: $49/year billed upfront (~$4.08/month) for income-qualified members. annualDiscountPct = (6.47-4.08)/6.47 rounded.

plans.name: Walmart InHome Monthly
plans.notes: $19.95/month. Includes all standard Walmart+ benefits plus in-home grocery delivery — Walmart associates place groceries inside your door, garage, or refrigerator (where smart lock/compatible hardware available).

vendors.name: Amazon Prime
vendors.provenance: Official amazon.com/prime returned HTTP 503. Pricing re-verified 2026-06-14 against dealnews.com (How Much Is Amazon Prime, June 2026), which states the standard membership is $14.99/month or $139/year, with the $139 annual rate held since 2022. Amazon Fresh same-day grocery delivery is included with Prime in eligible zip codes. VERIFIER NOTE: the previously listed $12.99 monthly figure was the 2018 price and was stale; corrected to the current $14.99/month.

plans.name: Prime Monthly
plans.notes: $14.99/month. Includes Amazon Fresh grocery delivery (in eligible zip codes), Prime Video, Amazon Music, Prime Reading, free fast shipping, and more. 30-day free trial for new members.

plans.name: Prime Annual
plans.notes: $139/year billed upfront (~$11.58/month). Annual price held at $139 since the February 2022 increase from $119. annualDiscountPct = (14.99-11.58)/14.99 rounded.

vendors.name: Shipt
integrations: Target (Shipt is owned by Target Corporation)
vendors.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-14 directly from help.shipt.com/pricing/how-much-is-a-shipt-membership, which publishes two self-serve plans: Monthly $10.99/month and Yearly $99/year, plus a $4.99/month student membership. VERIFIER NOTE: the previously asserted 'no monthly plan exists' was incorrect — Shipt does publish a confirmable $10.99/month self-serve plan, which has been added.

plans.name: Shipt Monthly Membership
plans.notes: $10.99/month. Unlimited deliveries; free delivery on orders over $35 from Target and many other retailers (orders under $35 incur a $7 fee). 14-day free trial available.

plans.name: Shipt Annual Membership
plans.notes: $99/year billed upfront (~$8.25/month). Same benefits as monthly. annualDiscountPct = (10.99-8.25)/10.99 rounded.

vendors.name: DashPass (DoorDash)
vendors.provenance: Official help.doordash.com/consumers/s/article/What-is-DashPass returns full content with pricing: $9.99/month or $96/year ($8/month). Re-verified 2026-06-14 against dealnews.com (How Much Is DashPass, June 2026), confirming the same standard tiers.

plans.name: DashPass Monthly
plans.notes: $9.99/month. $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible DoorDash and Caviar orders over $12. Cancel anytime.

plans.name: DashPass Annual
plans.notes: $96/year billed upfront ($8/month). Same benefits as monthly plan. Saves $23.88 vs 12 months at $9.99. annualDiscountPct = (9.99-8.00)/9.99 rounded.

vendors.name: Target Circle 360
vendors.provenance: Official target.com Circle 360 page is JS-rendered. Pricing re-verified 2026-06-14 from help.shipt.com/how-much-is-a-target-circle-360-membership- (Shipt powers Target Circle 360 delivery), which publishes: Annual $99/year, Monthly $10.99/month, Student $4.99 (annual-verified), and a $49/year Target Circle Card holder rate. VERIFIER NOTE: the previously asserted 'no monthly plan published' was incorrect — a confirmable $10.99/month self-serve plan exists and has been added.

plans.name: Target Circle 360 Monthly
plans.notes: $10.99/month. Unlimited free same-day delivery (powered by Shipt) on orders over $35, free standard shipping with no minimum, and exclusive Target Circle deals.

plans.name: Target Circle 360 Annual
plans.notes: $99/year billed upfront (~$8.25/month). Same benefits as monthly. annualDiscountPct = (10.99-8.25)/10.99 rounded.

plans.name: Target Circle 360 Annual — Student/Circle Card Rate
plans.notes: $49/year (~$4.08/month) for verified students and Target Circle Card holders. Same benefits as standard annual plan. annualDiscountPct = (8.25-4.08)/8.25 rounded vs standard annual monthly equivalent.

vendors.name: Kroger Boost
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified 2026-06-14. Kroger publishes two Boost tiers. VERIFIER NOTE: the previous single-tier $99/year-only entry was materially incomplete. Per thekrazycouponlady.com and grocerydive.com (reflecting the April 10 2025 price change): Boost Essential is $69/year or $8.99/month (next-day delivery, 2x fuel points); Boost is $99/year or $12.99/month (same-day delivery, 2x fuel points, plus an annual streaming subscription option of Disney+ with Ads / Hulu with Ads / ESPN+). Monthly options for both tiers were previously omitted and have been added.

plans.name: Kroger Boost Essential Monthly
plans.notes: $8.99/month. Free next-day delivery on orders of $35 or more and 2x fuel points on qualifying grocery purchases. Requires a free Kroger Plus card.

plans.name: Kroger Boost Essential Annual
plans.notes: $69/year billed upfront (~$5.75/month). Free next-day delivery on $35+ orders and 2x fuel points. Price rose from $59 to $69 on April 10 2025. annualDiscountPct = (8.99-5.75)/8.99 rounded.

plans.name: Kroger Boost Monthly
plans.notes: $12.99/month. Free same-day delivery (in as little as two hours) on $35+ orders, 2x fuel points, and an annual streaming subscription option (Disney+ with Ads, Hulu with Ads, or ESPN+). Requires a free Kroger Plus card.

plans.name: Kroger Boost Annual
plans.notes: $99/year billed upfront (~$8.25/month). Free same-day delivery, 2x fuel points, and a streaming subscription option. annualDiscountPct = (12.99-8.25)/12.99 rounded.
